description: This Java class 'ConfigurationController' is part of a Spring MVC web application. It manages the configuration settings in the admin backend, including account configurations, email settings, and their respective view and save operations.

classes.name: ConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling admin configuration pages, including account settings and email configuration.

methods.name: displayAccountsConfguration
methods.description: Handles GET request to display account configuration settings, loading existing configurations or creating defaults if absent.

methods.name: saveConfigurations
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update merchant account configurations based on submitted data.

methods.name: displayEmailSettings
methods.description: Handles GET request to display email configuration settings, either loaded from existing configuration or defaults.

methods.name: saveEmailSettings
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update email configuration settings.

methods.name: setConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu states for the configuration section.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu states for the email configuration section.
